LESSON: KUSOMA 2.2.1 KUSOMA KWA KINA

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: MICHEZO Mada Mada Ndogo Matokeo Maalum Yanayotarajiwa Mapendekezo ya Shughuli za
Topic 2.2: Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua maana tahajia, ngeli na aina za maneno kwa kutumia kamusi
2. kutumia kamusi ipasavyo kutafuta maana za maneno mageni yaliyo katika matini aliyosoma ili kukuza msamiati wake

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua maana tahajia, ngeli na aina za maneno kwa kutumia kamusi
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua maana tahajia, ngeli na aina za maneno kwa kutumia kamusi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutumia kamusi ipasavyo kutafuta maana za maneno mageni yaliyo katika matini aliyosoma ili kukuza msamiati wake
   In simple words: practise until you can kutumia kamusi ipasavyo kutafuta maana za maneno mageni yaliyo katika matini aliyosoma ili kukuza msamiati wake. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina in the examples.
2. Explain Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina.
4. Show that you can: kutambua maana tahajia, ngeli na aina za maneno kwa kutumia kamusi

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua maana tahajia, ngeli na aina za maneno kwa kutumia kamusi
2. kutumia kamusi ipasavyo kutafuta maana za maneno mageni yaliyo katika matini aliyosoma ili kukuza msamiati wake

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
